name: Reject a handoff whose tests are already green, cannot execute, or time out
Reject a test seat that changes production code or leaves tests uncommitted
Run mutation on implemented HEAD with locked tests as exact arguments in a private clone
Refuse mutation on an unreadable base, unrelated history, or zero remaining tests; reproduce before fix
DeepSeek, GLM, and Sonnet cannot change or delete handed-over tests or add their own tests
Count distinct failed Sonnet rounds, request Opus at round two, never escalate an unknown strong model down
